Footer.tagline: Preserving the foundations of civilization. Building future values.

HomePage.intro_title: Preserving the Foundations of Civilization – Building Future Values.
HomePage.intro_body: As the nation's leading specialized research institution, the Heritage Conservation Institute proudly carries the historic mission: Researching, surveying, planning, and designing the restoration of ancient architectural complexes and culturally significant works of the Vietnamese people.
HomePage.events_banner_body: Join leading domestic and international experts.

PostPage.timeline_subtitle: Historical chronicle of the Heritage Conservation Institute

Timeline.event_1982_desc: The predecessor of the Heritage Conservation Institute was established to meet the urgent need for maintenance and preservation of architectural heritage severely degraded after the war.
Timeline.event_1990_title: Upgraded to Center for Design & Restoration
Timeline.event_1990_desc: Expanded from physical restoration to large-scale design and restoration project consulting, marking a transformation in traditional wooden architecture conservation.
Timeline.event_1999_desc: Established regional offices and survey networks, directly undertaking restoration of the Hue Monuments Complex, Hoi An Ancient Town, and My Son Sanctuary (later recognized as UNESCO World Heritage sites).
Timeline.event_2007_desc: By the Prime Minister's Decision, the Institute became the leading national research agency for heritage conservation with 4 main areas: Research, Training, Design, and Restoration Construction.
Timeline.event_2018_desc: Launched the 'Digital Heritage Database of Ancient Architecture', applying 3D Laser Scanning technology to preserve Vietnam's heritage sites for future generations.
Timeline.event_Nay_desc: With countless National and Special-National heritage restoration projects, the Institute continues to uphold the banner of knowledge, preserving the nation's soul through every rafter and tile.
